% titletoc's run-in entries, \titlecontents*, each of which leaves a group
% open until the next entry or \contentsfinish. In report: a subsection
% with the five mandatory arguments only, and a subsubsection after it
% with the optional separator and end, two adjacent run-in levels, under
% a non-starred \titlecontents for the section. The subsubsections are
% below report's tocdepth and secnumdepth, so they stay out of the table
% of contents, as in the PDF. No hyperref.
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage{titletoc}
\titlecontents{section}[1.5em]{}{\contentslabel{2.3em}}{}
    {\titlerule*[1pc]{.}\contentspage}
\titlecontents*{subsection}[3.7pc]{}{}{}{}
\titlecontents*{subsubsection}[5pc]{\small}{\thecontentslabel\ }{}
    {, \thecontentspage}[;\ ][.]
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\chapter{Opening chapter}
Text of the opening chapter.
\section{First section}
Text of the first section.
\subsection{First run-in}
Text of the first run-in.
\subsubsection{Deep one}
Text of deep one.
\subsection{Second run-in with \emph{italic} and $x^2$}
Text of the second run-in.
\section{Second section}
Text of the second section.
\chapter{Closing chapter}
\section{Last section}
Text of the last section.
\end{document}
